title: Irish Cheese Wrap
description: A simple, warm, and satisfying snack with Irish flair.

ingredients.name: Warm Irish Wrap
ingredients.notes: preferably made with whole wheat flour

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Place the wrap in the pan and cook for 1-2 minutes, until slightly toasted.
4. Flip the wrap and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
5. Sprinkle cheddar cheese over the wrap.
6. Add fresh cilantro on top (if using).
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
8. Fold the wrap in half to keep the cheese inside.
9. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the cheese is melted and the wrap is crispy.
10. Remove from heat and serve immediately.
